NOTE: (context on Burnham/climate tension, 17 Jul; PA-syndicated) Green groups wary of Burnham on climate amid North Sea drilling reports. Amy Cameron (Greenpeace programme director): drilling would be "a massive own goal for Andy Burnham." Tessa Khan (Uplift exec director): "New North Sea drilling will not take a penny off our bills." NB: these quotes concern North Sea licences, NOT the bus-fare climate-finance switch — do not misattribute. Use only as background that Burnham's green flank is already restive, sharpening scrutiny of diverting £400m of international climate finance to fund buses.
